name: Helen Wells
headlineFirst: Creative copy. Strategic SEO. Meaningful results.
introduction: I’m Helen Wells, an SEO copywriter and marketing specialist. I create search-informed website copy, destination guides, and engaging articles that help readers find what they need and brands tell their stories.
aboutHeading: A writer with a strategy behind every word.
aboutBody: I’ve always loved storytelling. I studied English with a concentration in literature and a minor in journalism at Georgia State University, then discovered content marketing through a college internship. Since graduating in 2023, I’ve brought that background to SEO-focused website copy, destination guides, and informative articles for travel, vacation rental, and renter-focused audiences. My approach starts with the reader, considers search intent, and aims to make every piece clear, useful, and engaging.
aboutNote: I enjoy finding the balance between what people are searching for and what makes a story worth reading.
education: Georgia State University · English (Literature concentration) · Minor in Journalism
experienceHeading: Content that meets readers where they are.
experienceBody: At Bluetent / Inhabit, I developed SEO-focused website copy, destination guides, blog articles, and digital marketing content for vacation rental clients across the country. My published writing also includes renter education, property management, lifestyle, and home décor. I balance keyword research and on-page SEO with storytelling that helps readers find genuinely useful answers.
experienceFocus: SEO content • destination guides • digital marketing
